visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, dark, wavy hair wearing a denim shirt sits on a grey couch behind a wooden table. He holds a large bag of North Sea Dried Shredded Squid and gestures enthusiastically towards it. Two smaller red bags of snacks are placed on the table in front of him. The lighting is bright and warm, provided by a white lamp in the background. (2) Close-up shots of various snack packages. One bag features a green label with the words 'Qinghua Pepper' and graphics of green peppercorns. Another shot shows the shredded squid strips on a small yellow dish, where the hand points at the texture of the product. The background changes slightly to a more focused view of the product. (3) The man tastes the product, exhibiting wide-eyed expressions and nodding as he chews. He holds two different red bags of shredded squid, comparing them by pointing to the labels. High-density yellow and white text overlays appear over his torso. (4) The scene shifts to a kitchen environment. A white pot is seen on a portable electric stove with yellow liquid (porridge) bubbling inside. A hand adds a handful of shredded squid into the pot and stirs it with a wooden spatula. Later, black pepper from a shaker and chopped green onions are added as garnishes. (5) Back to the man, who is now holding a pink bowl of the prepared porridge. He uses a spoon to take a bite, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied smile. He continues talking while gesturing with his hands and holding several bags of the snack at the end.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 鱈魚香絲新口味 睽違50年. [Subtitle]: 你敢信 北海鱈魚香絲睽違50年推出一堆新口味. (2) [Subtitle]: 好市多獨賣青花椒口味. [Variety]: 青花椒. (3) [Subtitle]: 入口味道還沒出來. (4) [Subtitle]: 咀嚼後椒麻香氣散出. (5) [Subtitle]: 麻感就上來了. (6) [Subtitle]: 一大包耶. (7) [Subtitle]: 已經被我吃半包. (8) [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈. (9) [Subtitle]: 接下是家樂福限定的兩款口味 一個是墨西哥風味 一個是明太子風味. (10) [Subtitle]: 只是為什麼 墨西哥的比較粗. (11) [Subtitle]: 大概兩三分辣而已 如果不吃辣的人. (12) [Subtitle]: 淡淡辣醬佐上去 加上一點蒜香味. (13) [Subtitle]: 我覺得滿搭耶. [Variety]: 明太子風味. (14) [Subtitle]: 一點一點的 應該算是明太子點在上面吧. (15) [Subtitle]: 吃起來 很不像鱈魚香絲. (16) [Subtitle]: 假蟹肉棒 就是火鍋料. (17) [Subtitle]: 我是覺得青花椒 口感跟味道比較強烈 很適合拿來做其他料理. (18) [Subtitle]: 不然來做粥 挑戰看看好了. [Slogan]: 青花椒鱈魚香絲煮粥. (19) [Variety]: 胡椒. [Variety]: 蔥花點綴. (20) [Subtitle]: 鱈魚香絲本身就有魚味. (21) [Subtitle]: 讓粥多了香氣. (22) [Subtitle]: 重點是吃到鱈魚香絲 辣感又突然加劇. (23) [Subtitle]: 加點鮮魚片 加點鯛魚片 加點香菇. (24) [Subtitle]: 變化出無窮美味 感謝鱈魚香絲老董. (25) [Subtitle]: 50年終於做事了.
